verdict.rationale: Lowenstein Sandler is a law firm offering legal services, not a software product. User-defined event-triggered automation rules are a category error for this kind of product. The evidence (practice-area pages, the Clerky formation partnership, llms.txt) shows no rules engine or event-driven automation that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
